situation: Two sisters who both follow the same true crime podcast.
topic: Talking through the gruesome forensic details of an invented serial killer case, the injuries to the victims, the killer's psychology, and whether they find it disturbing or fascinating.

text: have you listened to the new one yet 👀
Not yet, got in about an hour ago and haven't sat down properly. Why, is it good?
its SO good but also genuinely disturbing like more than usual
the bit about the third victim
Right I'm putting it on now
Ok I'm about halfway through
The staging thing is wild
RIGHT like why go to that effort
It's about control isn't it. That's the whole point they keep making
yeah but the positioning specifically, that felt personal to me? like he knew them or wanted to
Or he wanted investigators to think that
ohhh I hadn't thought about that
deliberate misdirection
They touch on it in the second half I think, finish it and come back to me
ok finishing my tea and then im back on it
finished
the wound pattern analysis 😶
I know. The forensic woman was very matter of fact about it which somehow made it worse
exactly!! like she just said it. the number of strikes. and I was eating
Why are you always eating during the grim bits
its not on purpose it just happens
but do you think they're right about the cooling off period being so short? that felt off to me
In what way
like they're saying 11 days between victim 2 and 3 but he was apparently escalating so fast, surely the risk he was taking would slow him down not speed him up
I think that's the point though, the risk becomes part of it. They said that in the first episode, the threshold keeps moving
yeah fair
it's so bleak when you think about it properly
It is. I find I can listen fine and then I stop and think about it being actual people, even if it's not, and it hits differently
yeah I get that. like the podcast format makes it feel like a puzzle and then you catch yourself
does that make us bad
No I think it's just how the brain processes it. Distance is the only way you can engage with it without it being unbearable
that's very teacher of you
Shut up 😄
the offender profile section was the best bit though. the bit about how ordinary he seemed to everyone around him
That always gets me more than the forensics honestly
The idea that you just wouldn't know
like his neighbour description. just a quiet guy. kept to himself
they always keep to themselves 😭
In fairness a lot of quiet people just keep to themselves
yes lesley thank you for that
Just saying
do you think they'll do a follow up episode on the disposal sites? they glossed over it
Probably. There's clearly more to say about the timeline there
I want them to get the geographic profiler back on, she was brilliant
Yes she was really good. Explained it without being condescending
right I need to actually do something with my evening I've just been lying here since I got in
Same honestly. I should do marking
on a friday night??
No you're right, it can wait
correct answer
did you do the marking
Some of it. Enough to not feel terrible
respectable
I'm in town if you need anything from anywhere
No I'm fine thanks. Getting much?
just bits. nearly bought a coat I don't need
Did you get it
yes
Right so I bumped into Claire Henderson in Waitrose
You remember her, she was in my year at school
vaguely? dark hair?
Yeah. Anyway she's apparently been listening to the same podcast
We stood in the dairy aisle for about twenty minutes talking about offender profiling
omg 😂 did you feel like a weirdo
A bit. But she brought it up first
the podcast is everywhere right now
She had the same thing you said actually, about the cooling off period
see!! it does feel off
I still think I'm right but fine
you and your threshold theory
It's not my theory, it's theirs
you've adopted it very enthusiastically
have they put out anything extra on the feed or is it just the main episode
Just the main one I think. Why
wanted to know if there was more on the disposal sites before next week
I'd say wait for the episode, they'll do it properly
yeah you're right
I stayed up too late again
Same. Night
night 🌙
